Standing comfortably on both feet, three-quarter side view facing screen-left toward an approaching driver. One hand gives a small relaxed greeting at shoulder height, the other hangs naturally. Full body including shoes and every finger must be visible, with generous transparent margin, centered single figure, large master at least 1024px tall. Broad softly shaded cloth folds and believable skin, same restrained painterly realism and edge treatment as the actual truck, not flat vector, no heavy outline. Diffuse overcast daylight from upper-left, neutral ambient, no dramatic cast shadow; a tiny soft contact shadow only under shoes. No cups, no vehicle, no facility, no ground plane, no scenery, no other people, no named companion likeness. Actual transparent alpha background, NOT checkerboard artwork or white matte. This is a transparent renderer part, not a cinematic event illustration.
